# Sayward

Sayward generates deterministic scripts for difficult conversations.

## Machine-payable API

- Service metadata: https://sayward.bmparent.chatgpt.site/api/v1
- OpenAPI discovery: https://sayward.bmparent.chatgpt.site/api/v1/openapi.json
- Paid endpoint: POST https://sayward.bmparent.chatgpt.site/api/v1/plan
- Payment protocol: Machine Payments Protocol (HTTP 402)
- Payment methods: Tempo and Stripe (the live discovery document lists configured offers)
- Price: $0.50 USD per completed plan
- Documentation: https://sayward.bmparent.chatgpt.site/agents

Valid requests are checked before payment. A paid retry returns JSON and a Payment-Receipt header.

Sayward is writing support only. It is not legal, medical, employment, crisis, or safety advice.
